$comment: Drain merge-queue safeguards: drain.waitForRedTeamBeforeEnqueue and drain.dequeueOnSendBack are booleans, both standard true. Inherit platform drain preferences unless deliberately overriding here. Environment overrides WE_DRAIN_WAIT_FOR_RED_TEAM_BEFORE_ENQUEUE and WE_DRAIN_DEQUEUE_ON_SEND_BACK accept true/false, 1/0, on/off. Effective values and sources are logged by both drain and red-team gate. Enqueue waits for the trusted post-accept red-team result comment on the exact live head when the head-bound review payload satisfies the shared review scheduler redTeamOwedFor decision and redTeamEnabled; labels alone do not establish an owed pass. A confirmed send-back break also withholds enqueue until routed. Send-back removes queue membership, confirms isInMergeQueue=false, and comments with the reason. The red-team gate acts immediately; drain checks all live open rows before candidate filtering and its durable queue follow-ups as a backstop. Pending red-team reads retry after drain.redTeamPendingBackoffSec (standard 300 seconds), or when preread comments show a new comment. Pending state is durable and bound to the live head. After drain.redTeamPendingMaxMin (standard 45 minutes) with an owed pass, return and log a health smell naming the PR. Recheck head-bound run evidence and complete comments at the deadline even during backoff. If no run is recorded or in flight, use an available review red-team request hook; without a request path, drain.enqueueWhenRedTeamNeverScheduled (standard true, env WE_DRAIN_ENQUEUE_WHEN_RED_TEAM_NEVER_SCHEDULED) permits enqueue with a loud red team never scheduled note and policy source. No standalone red-team request queue exists in the current drain host, so it uses this fallback. Recorded breaks and recorded or active runs remain held. Both positive numeric settings use the drain cascade, log their sources, and accept WE_DRAIN_RED_TEAM_PENDING_BACKOFF_SEC / WE_DRAIN_RED_TEAM_PENDING_MAX_MIN overrides. drain.prestageWhileCiRuns (boolean, standard true) and drain.prestageTtlMin (positive minutes, standard 30) resolve standard < platform < tool with sources logged. Approved pending heads carrying ready-to-merge run non-CI gates and cache head-bound dispositions in coordination storage. Green check events try this cache before listing, re-reading the head, labels, body/base, every required-check conclusion, the optional CodeQL gate and live red-team evidence. Expired or changed evidence falls back to the full fast drain. Live red required checks or a failed optional CodeQL gate drop preparation; unattributed non-success events preserve green wakes. Preparation never enqueues before the PR own required checks are green. Coupled candidates, manifest-carrying heads and branches requiring preparation retain full-drain handling.
